source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original interface-removal patch replaces QI with static_cast to nsMailboxUrl. The actual registered factory produces that concrete class on the inspected service route. Accepted later source uses do_QueryObject and explicitly rejects a missing concrete object during initialization; PrepareMessageUrl also checks the concrete result. Preserve the original assumption and later checks separately. These bounded producer/consumer proofs do not establish every external caller or an observed crash.
title: The original concrete mailbox casts and accepted object-query guards are different phases
